maxCompetitors: Up to {n} competitors; each is a separate request.
noCompetitorsText: Add competitors to the project or choose them above. You can add them with one click on the Competitors tab of the Domain overview.
linksHint: Sites linking to every chosen competitor but not to you; good link prospects
bulkPlaceholder: Type domains, one per line or separated by commas (empty: the project and its competitors)
bulkHint: Up to 100 domains; traffic and authority together
shareHint: How is market share worked out?
shareText: The estimated monthly organic traffic of the compared sites is added up; each site's share is its percentage of that total. Against competitors in the same market it shows the share of visibility.
matrixHintShort: Your site's and competitors' keywords side by side: shared, missing, weak, strong, untapped and unique
matrixHint: Each domain's first {n} keywords by traffic are compared.
groupHint_missing: Keywords every competitor ranks for and you do not: first targets.
groupHint_weak: Keywords every domain ranks for, with you below every competitor.
groupHint_strong: Keywords where you rank above every competitor that ranks.
groupHint_untapped: Keywords some competitors rank for and you do not.
pageGapHint: Keywords the competitor's page ranks for and yours does not: topics to add to your page
mapTitle: Market positions: keywords and traffic (bubble: OA)
shareHistoryHint: Each site's monthly share of the compared sites' organic traffic
categoriesHint: The product and service categories your site ranks in; choose one to see its leading sites
playersHint: The sites with the most organic traffic in the category and their change over a year
